title: Put the 'a first-test fail is not a dead idea' rule into research-ops, exit-refinement and perf-followup skills (diagnose -> outside research -> variant units)
note: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE 2026-10-22 (verbatim): "we don't just drop an idea because we ran one test and, like, it didn't pass. We need to figure out, like, we need to study them, we need to do open source research, we need to figure out how to build a bunch of different tests and tweak them, and figure out what has potential and what doesn't. Like, we're not just, like, those aren't dead. They're just not, they just didn't pass the first test or whatever." The rule exists in docs/plans/OPERATING-PLAN-2026-09-21.md ("never to just kill ideas because of one bad pass") but the lane-facing skills only cover FAMILY retirement (scripts/research/family_retirement_policy.yaml), so lanes and the manager read a fail as a dead idea (manager did so 2026-10-22). DONE WHEN: research-ops, exit-refinement and perf-followup SKILL.md each carry a results-read step: a FAIL settles only its registered live/config question; diagnose why; outside-source check; author variant units; programme status 'first test failed -> variants queued'.
